global_caveat: Evidence points are not consecutive exclusive eras. Claims, filings, public observations and inferred dates are separate.

cards.label: EARLY REGISTRY EMBLEM
cards.title: Geometric emblem
cards.body: An early vertical emblem with a separate upper component. CIPO claims use from 1 March 1974; the filing followed on 6 May.
cards.evidence: Earliest substantiated evidence located in this research. Public retirement remains unknown.

cards.label: HALF-DISC + NAME
cards.title: Related early lockups
cards.body: CIPO records the abbreviated arrangement: filed 12 January, advertised 17 May 1989. The full-name variant is retained from your reference.
cards.evidence: The filing is not a launch date. The full-name reference’s folder year is not independently verified.

cards.label: SERIF ROAD BADGE
cards.title: Road motif + serif type
cards.body: The serif badge appears on the 1992 report’s back cover, with print code “2 93”. A separate road-logo record claims insurance use from March 1992.
cards.evidence: Circa 1992 is a qualified family date. The exact serif drawing’s launch and retirement are not established.

cards.label: SQUARE-CORNER SANS BADGE
cards.title: Heavier sans-serif type
cards.body: The square-corner sans version appears in both January 2007 and January 2008 service plans. Your “2005” vector is retained unchanged.
cards.evidence: The serif-to-sans changeover year remains unverified. These publication dates are not the complete lifespan.

cards.label: ROUNDED ROAD BADGE
cards.title: Modern rounded badge
cards.body: Blue use is claimed from January 2008. Rounded geometry appears in the January 2009 service plan; blue remains on the August 2026 report.
cards.evidence: A 2008 rollout is an inference from overlapping evidence, not a confirmed single changeover day.
